help.immersive_brewing.alembic.cool: Coolant valve %s / %s: too little lets vapour escape, too much chokes the coil.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.goal: Route the condensate: cloudy heads to waste, the clear heart to the receiver, the hazy tail back to waste.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.heat: Heat valve %s / %s: enough heat to run steadily, not so much that it rushes.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.receiver: Switch the receiver with %s or the receiver button. The marks are a guide; watch the condensate itself.
help.immersive_brewing.alembic.score: Collection counts 50%%, heat 30%%, cooling 20%%. A score of 35 or more raises quality, never above the cap.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.add: When the tray says Add now, press %s to tip in the shown ingredient. Early or late additions cost a little; a missed one is added for you at the end of its phase.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.goal: Tend the brew through Bloom, Infuse and Settle. Keep the heat marker in the shaded heat band and the circulation where the brew asks for it.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.heat: %s raises the burner's draft and %s lowers it: more draft, more heat. Heat has inertia: change the draft before the liquid gets there.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.score: Heat counts 40%%, circulation 35%%, additions 25%%. A score of %s brews exactly the normal potion; better work lasts longer and drinks faster.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.signature: Each reaction shows its own surface: foam, sediment, shimmer, streaks, bubbles, whorls, glints or motes. The written cues say what each needs.
help.immersive_brewing.kettle.stir: Hold %s or %s to stir; add %s for a vigorous stir. Release to let the liquid coast. Circles drawn over the liquid also stir.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.finish: Press %s or Done when the texture is right. The timer only resolves what is there; it never wastes the ingredient.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.fold: When the batch clumps, lift and fold with %s or a right click.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.goal: Break the ingredient down to the even texture shown, then stop. Overworking turns it to dust or splits an emulsion.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.move: Steer the pestle with the mouse in the bowl, or %s %s %s %s.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.press: Hold the left mouse button or %s to press. Firm pressure cracks coarse pieces; finish with a lighter touch.
help.immersive_brewing.mortar.score: Extraction is 70%% reaching the endpoint and 30%% restraint: avoiding too much pressure and needless work.
help.immersive_brewing.seal: Escape or Seal stores the batch exactly as it is. Resume it later from the station; nothing is lost and nothing rerolls.

jei.immersive_brewing.info.alembic: Purification: three identical, unrefined potions become two with better quality, once per batch and never above the cap. Reclamation: three unwanted potions become Spent Alchemical Salt and their bottles. The bucket in its recipe is part of the apparatus and is consumed.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.carrier: Carries up to six potion stacks exactly as they are. Use it on a Kettle to collect finished bottles or to load an empty rack. It has no effect of its own and can not hold other containers.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.kettle: Brews one to six bottles of one kind through one hands-on reaction. Load bottles in the rack, reagents in the tray, blaze powder as fuel and a paddle, then choose a plan. One reagent covers up to three bottles; one blaze powder gives 20 fuel charges. Quality from your work changes effect duration and drinking time within bounds; a score of 50 is exactly the normal potion.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.mortar: Prepares one to four kits of an effect reagent in one short session. A kit replaces one reagent in a Kettle brew and carries the extraction you earned; raw reagents count as 50.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.notebook: The built-in guide: stations, controls, quality, recovery, every supported recipe, favourites, your last result and free practice. Hold a brewed potion in the other hand to label it.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.paddle: Stirs the Kettle; each finished brew wears it by one. An iron paddle lasts longer but adds no quality. Accepts Unbreaking and Mending.
jei.immersive_brewing.info.recovery: Dropped when a station breaks during a job: it holds everything the job owned. Install it at an idle station of the same kind to continue; it can not be opened by hand.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.1: Every control has a key you can rebind under Controls, and the screens always show the current binding.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.2: Kettle: the draft keys (W and S by default) raise and lower the burner, the stir keys circulate, the add key tips in the next ingredient. Mortar: steer and press the pestle, fold when it clumps, finish when the texture is right. Alembic: heat and coolant valves and the receiver switch.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.3: Escape seals the work exactly where it is. Holding controls can be switched to toggles, and the server may allow slower, wider assisted controls.
notebook.immersive_brewing.controls.4: The help overlay (H by default) pauses the game while it is open, in practice too, and shows one short page at a time. Closed mid-game, it counts in again before play continues.
notebook.immersive_brewing.favorites.int: Favourite plans appear first in the Kettle's plan list. Star a plan there to add it.
notebook.immersive_brewing.mode.coexist: This server keeps the ordinary brewing stand working beside the Kettle.
notebook.immersive_brewing.mode.disabled: Brewing jobs are disabled on this server; existing batches can still be resumed or recovered.
notebook.immersive_brewing.mode.replace_: On this server the brewing stand refuses transformations the Kettle covers; use the Kettle for those.
notebook.immersive_brewing.practice.1: Practice uses the same games with nothing used and nothing made. It never counts as real work.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.1: Quality is 25%% extraction (preparation) and 75%% brewing control. Crude 0-34, Standard 35-69, Fine 70-89, Masterwork 90-100.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.2: A score of 50 brews exactly the normal potion. Each point above or below changes effect duration by 0.4%%: from 0.8× at 0 to 1.2× at 100. Drinking takes 36 ticks at 0, 32 at 50 and 28 at 100.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.3: Quality never changes an amplifier, never turns a potion into its extended or strong form and never adds bottles. Instant healing and harming keep their exact strength.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.4: Adding redstone, glowstone or a container to a finished potion can never raise its quality. Only the Alembic can, once, and never to Masterwork.
notebook.immersive_brewing.quality.title: Quality
notebook.immersive_brewing.reagents.hint: Short controlled presses; holding force too long makes fines.
Crack the coarse crystals with firm presses, then lighten up before it turns to dust.
Gentle circular pressure; fold often to expose unworked fibres.
Fold and emulsify; pressing harder does little.
Low, even pressure: uniform mashing beats speed.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recipes.intro: Costs shown for %s servings. Every listed step is checked against the real brewing rules when the world loads.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recipes.stand: Every vanilla path here also works in an ordinary brewing stand unless the server uses replacement mode. Paths added by other mods may need an adapter.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recovery.1: Closing the screen, logging out, dying, changing dimension or walking away seals a running batch. Nothing is lost and nothing rerolls; open the station and press Resume.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recovery.2: Breaking a station with a job inside drops one Recovery Batch with everything the job held. Install it at an idle station of the same kind to continue.
notebook.immersive_brewing.recovery.3: If a mod or datapack the batch needs disappears, the batch is held for recovery instead of being deleted, and comes back when the data does.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.1: Brewing by hand needs three things: a Brewer's Kettle, a brewing paddle and blaze powder for its burner.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.2: Load up to six bottles of one kind into the rack, the reagents into the tray and blaze powder into the fuel slot, then choose a plan. The plan shows every step, the exact cost and what is missing.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.3: A batch of up to three bottles costs one reagent per step, like a brewing stand. Six bottles cost two. One session always serves the whole batch.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.4: Prepare effect reagents in an Apothecary's Mortar first for better extraction, or use them raw. Practice any game for free from this notebook.
notebook.immersive_brewing.start.no_reci: No crafting recipe for the Brewer's Kettle is loaded in this world.

notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.1: Apothecary's Mortar: prepares one to four kits of an effect reagent in one session. A kit replaces one reagent in a brew and carries the extraction you earned.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.2: Brewer's Kettle: brews one to six servings through one reaction. Bottles are transformed in place; it never consumes extra bottles.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.3: Alembic: purifies three identical, unrefined potions into two better ones, once per batch, or reclaims unwanted potions into Spent Alchemical Salt and their bottles.
notebook.immersive_brewing.stations.4: Hoppers may fill trays and fuel and take finished bottles. They can never take what a job has reserved.

tip.immersive_brewing.brew.early: Wait for the tray to say Add now before adding the %s.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.excellent: Excellent work: keep doing exactly this.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.heat_cold: In %s the heat ran cold: raise the draft a little earlier; heat lags behind the burner.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.heat_hot: In %s the heat ran hot: lower the draft before the marker reaches the top of the band.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.idle: Nothing was done this session: set the draft and stir.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.late: Add the %s as soon as the tray says Add now.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.missed: The %s was added for you at the end of its phase: watch the tray and press Add.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.ali: In %s keep the stirring calm late in the phase.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.blo: In %s keep a gentle stir so the bubbles stay even.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.dar: In %s rest quietly after each addition.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.del: In %s fold slowly and keep the heat low.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.den: In %s lift the sediment with a brief strong stir, then circulate gently.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.flo: In %s a gentle, steady circulation draws the motes under.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.lig: In %s keep a steady, moderate stir: thrashing raises foam, stillness lets it linger.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.mag: In %s keep circulating steadily until the streaks blend.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.non: Keep the circulation inside its band.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.set: In %s let the brew rest: stop stirring.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.signature.sus: In %s reverse the stir when the cue appears to release the bubbles.
tip.immersive_brewing.brew.unattended: The %s phase was left alone: every phase needs some tending.
tip.immersive_brewing.distill.cooling: Keep the coolant in its band: too little lets vapour escape, too much chokes the coil.
tip.immersive_brewing.distill.heads: Switch to collecting a little later, when the condensate turns clear.
tip.immersive_brewing.distill.heat: Hold the still's heat in its band for a steadier run.
tip.immersive_brewing.distill.missed_hea: Collect the whole clear run: switch sooner and back later.
tip.immersive_brewing.distill.tails: Switch back to waste as soon as haze appears.
tip.immersive_brewing.distill.too_slow: The run was too slow: more heat and enough coolant.
tip.immersive_brewing.prep.ease_pressure: Ease the pressure as the material breaks down.
tip.immersive_brewing.prep.no_work: Press while you move the pestle.
tip.immersive_brewing.prep.overworked: Stop when the texture matches the endpoint: you went past it.
tip.immersive_brewing.prep.ran_out: Work a little faster: time ran out before the endpoint.
tip.immersive_brewing.prep.stop_sooner: Stop as soon as the texture is even; extra work only costs.
tip.immersive_brewing.prep.stopped_early: Keep working: you stopped before the endpoint.
